about: Keeps one tab stop for a set of controls. Tab reaches the set, and the arrow keys move focus inside it.

both.about: Eight filters in a 320px room, wrapping onto three lines. With `orientation="both"` every arrow key moves focus to the next or previous filter.
both.title: Both

title: Roving focus

toolbar.about: A formatting toolbar with `wrap`. Tab reaches Bold, the item with the tab stop, and the second cell renders its focused state. ArrowRight moves to Italic, and on Underline it moves back to Bold.
toolbar.title: Toolbar

vertical.about: A vertical toolbar. ArrowDown and ArrowUp move focus, and ArrowLeft and ArrowRight reach the page.
vertical.title: Vertical
